name: mac-compromise-check
description: Run a read-only compromise triage on a macOS machine: accounts, remote access, listening ports, launchd/cron persistence, code signatures, DYLD/TCC, browser extensions, MDM/config profiles, and system hardening (FileVault/SIP/Gatekeeper). Trace a specific email or account across the machine. Use when the user says 'is my Mac hacked', 'check if my Mac is compromised', 'did someone access my machine', shows a suspicious sign-in, or wants a security audit of their laptop.
